lines.differs: Easier for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: no requirement for timesheets to be approved by a project lead before payment.
Easier for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment is due in 30 days instead of 45 days, improving cash flow for the contractor.
Easier for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: no 12% annual interest penalty for delayed payments.
Tougher on AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ gains full ownership of work product instead of just a license, but only after payment.
Broadly like Al Noor Hospitality Group: ownership of specific deliverables vests in the client upon payment, while the contractor retains pre-existing tools.
Broadly like Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: work product ownership transfers to AtliQ only upon full payment for the services.
Tougher on AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: includes protection for the company's own clients' data, but lacks the specific three-year survival period.
Easier for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: removes the specific requirement to comply with written client-notified data security policies and device restrictions.
Easier for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: confidentiality obligations do not have a fixed two-year expiration after the contract ends.
Easier for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: the non-solicitation restriction only applies to employees 'knowingly' targeted and worked with during the project.
Tougher on AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: mutual non-solicitation applies to both parties, whereas Crestline only restricted the client for 12 months.
Tougher on AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: liability cap exclusion is expanded to include 'willful misconduct' alongside fraud and confidentiality breaches.
Tougher on AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: liability is capped at 12 months of fees rather than the total fees of the statement of work.
Easier for AtliQ than CareBridge Clinics Inc: aggregate liability is limited to 1x annual fees instead of the 2x cap previously signed previously.
